name: Trap the Trespassers
oracle_text: Secret council — Each player secretly votes for a creature you don't control, then those votes are revealed. For each creature with one or more votes, put that many stun counters on it, then tap it. (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
blocked_sentences: Secret council — Each player secretly votes for a creature you don't control, then those votes are revealed. For each creature with one or more votes, put that many stun counters on it, then tap it.

needs.what: a vote op (rule 701.38) over objects: every player secretly chooses one object from a selector (here creatures the spell's controller doesn't control) without targeting, votes revealed simultaneously (secret council); the op keeps a per-candidate tally and binds the set of candidates with one or more votes under an `as`, with a value key reading the vote count of the current object, so a following for_each can add_counters of kind stun with amount = that object's votes and then tap it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: for_each_player can walk the players but choose_permanents has no per-player chooser and no binding that accumulates across players; no value_key counts how many players chose a given object, so 'put that many stun counters on it' has no amount; targeting would be wrong because the vote does not target. add_counters (counter: stun) and tap are themselves available, so only the vote and tally are missing
